lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible across the mid-lateral flank, extending posteriorly from the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of luminance maxima, creating a visible lattice-like arrangement across the upper flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient consisting of light-reflective upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The posterior margin of the visible pectoral fin exhibits irregular notches or jagged indentations.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral region of the body, trailing posterior to the pectoral fin's insertion point.
